text:
Aisha (Product): Hey team — urgent Q. I'm in Barcelona for a conference and the clinic here says they need pre-authorization for a same-day MRI. I left my physical insurance card at home. Can People Ops or benefits generate a temporary proof of coverage or submit the preauth for me? Plan: Redwood Choice HMO, member ID 7C12345 (it's on my portal).

Ben (Benefits): Hi Aisha — yep we can help. First quick options: 1) digital ID from the benefits portal (Workday benefits -> ID card) — you can screenshot that. 2) We can file the preauth on your behalf if you share the clinic name, NPI, and CPT code. What's the clinic + MRI code?

Aisha (Product): Clinic: Clínica Sant Jordi, Barcelona. Provider NPI unknown, doc says CPT 70551 (MRI brain w/o contrast). MRI is tomorrow AM. They said they need either a preauth number or a member ID card to book. I can get my passport and an email from the portal, but need something official-looking.

People-Ops-Bot: Quick checklist: 1) Download digital ID from benefits portal and forward to benefits@redwood.com. 2) If you want People Ops to submit preauth, include: patient name, DOB, member ID, provider name, provider address, NPI (if available), CPT code, date of service, and clinical reason. Attach any clinic estimate.

Devon (People Ops): @Aisha I can take this. Two things: A) I'll request a temporary e-card PDF from the carrier (they usually provide a one-page member proof within 30–60 mins) and B) I'll start a preauth submission with the clinical reason you give. Can you paste the patient's DOB and the clinic phone number?

Aisha (Product): DOB 1990-06-12. Clinic phone: +34 93 123 4567. Clinical reason: severe, persistent headaches w/ new onset over 2 weeks.

Devon (People Ops): Thanks. Submitting now. For the carrier we need this payload — I'm pasting the template I send them:

```
Patient: Aisha [redacted]
DOB: 1990-06-12
Member ID: 7C12345
Service: MRI Brain w/o contrast (CPT 70551)
Provider: Clínica Sant Jordi, Barcelona
Provider phone: +34 93 123 4567
Date requested: 2026-03-24 (ASAP)
Clinical reason: severe persistent headaches, new onset, neurology referral
Attachments: clinic estimate / appointment request
```

Devon (People Ops): I just submitted that to the carrier's international claims/preauth line and also requested an e-card PDF to email you. If the clinic needs a preauth number I'll post it here. If they only need proof of coverage, forward them the e-card screenshot I just emailed to you.

Ben (Benefits): One extra note — for out-of-network providers abroad the carrier sometimes accepts the e-card + a phone confirmation. If they insist on a preauth number, wait for Devon's confirmation. Also keep receipts and an itemized bill if you end up paying and need reimbursement.

Aisha (Product): Thanks! If I do end up paying, what's the fastest way to get reimbursed?

Ben (Benefits): Submit claim via the carrier portal once you have the itemized bill. If you need help, CC benefits@redwood.com and we'll fast-track. Include proof of payment, itemized invoice with CPT codes, and the preauth number if one was issued.

People-Ops-Bot: Update: preauth submitted (external ref PR-10234). Carrier estimated response time 2 hours for clinical review. E-card request sent.

Devon (People Ops): Carrier just approved preliminary coverage and issued temporary e-card PDF. Emailed that to you and to the clinic address you provided. Preauth number: 86-PR-99321. Please confirm the clinic booked the slot. :white_check_mark:

Aisha (Product): Got the e-card and the preauth number — they booked me for 09:00 tomorrow! Huge help, thank you Devon and team.

Ben (Benefits): You're welcome — safe travels. If you pay anything at the appointment, keep all receipts and send to benefits@redwood.com for reimbursement processing.

Aisha (Product): Will do. Closing the loop here. Thanks everyone! :pray:
